fills.notes: In the oldest cosmogonic sequence, the Living Spirit acts from/with the Mother of Life; the three elemental garments are assumed from the living treasury she provides, not from a later ecclesial source. This also fits the technical use of “garments” as elemental investitures.
The point is not moral action but infusion: he “pours”/instills powers into the garments so they become operative as cosmic media (wind, fire, water).
Connects the clause “in those three garments … he established them” with minimal, substrate-style linkage.
The garments are set as a structural disposition of the cosmos; “place where” leads naturally into “he was displayed” (i.e., manifested/appeared in ordered space).
After manifestation comes completion/finishing of works in the established media; this is the standard correspondential progression: investiture → ordering → completion.
Leads into the stripping-off: once the works are done, the powers invested in the garments are recollected/withdrawn.

The clause needs a relative: “the … which he stripped them off…”. The surviving “h” at the end suggests the editor saw a word ending in -h; in Coptic a relative/connector is plausible here in the transmission, but the sense required is simply a relative link.
The preserved start “the ri-” constrains strongly. In this substrate register, “the righteous ones” are the purified/ordered recipients witnessing the withdrawal of the invested media.
The syntax requires: “loose … them, and he divested himself…”. The bracket already includes “n them,”; restoring “and he” yields coherent action-sequence.
He is said to be “in them” (the garments) as an operative presence; “dwelled in them” preserves the impersonal cosmological sense of indwelling force.
A technical phrase for their fixed disposition/arrangement as cosmic strata around the zone.
The garments “clothe” the zone and its surrounding region; a spatial term is demanded by the subsequent “from below… up… above…”.
The passage describes graded vertical extension (below edges → upward tiers). A median station is typical in these stratified descriptions.
Balances the prior step and prepares for the stripping “at its topmost point.”
Subject needed for “above them strips them of the zone”: i.e., the transcendent agent/force above the garments performs the stripping at the summit.

assessment: Most gaps can be restored only to the level of required cosmological function (investiture → ordering → completion → withdrawal), because the surviving wording is thin. The strongest constraints are the fixed phrases ‘this universe’, ‘garments’, ‘the righteous’, and the vertical/zone mechanics in ¶2; specific named sources for the garments and the exact verbs (‘poured/placed/dwelt’) remain moderately to tentatively constrained.
